reason: The README clearly describes a native DeepSeek Harness memory plugin that ingests session messages, stores auditable facts, recalls and injects project context, and exposes memory management tools and UI.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可审计的项目记忆，自动 ingest 会话信息并在后续步骤中检索和注入相关上下文。
summaries.en: Provides auditable project memory for DeepSeek Harness by ingesting session messages and retrieving relevant context for subsequent agent steps.

capabilities: Automatically ingests human and assistant session messages into project memory
Stores and retrieves memory using embedded SQLite or an optional self-hosted HTTP backend
Injects recalled project memory into model context during agent steps
Uses the host-configured language model for optional memory digestion
Provides native remember, recall, facts, why, and forget tools
Provides a web settings interface to browse evidence chains and retire facts
